categories.multi_hop: Requires ≥2-hop graph traversal across documents (10 questions)
categories.ambiguous: Multiple valid answers — tests completeness (7 questions)
categories.out_of_domain: Information NOT in corpus — tests honest abstention (6 questions)

scoring_rules.correct: Answer contains the gold_answer or a valid subset (for ambiguous)
scoring_rules.hallucinated: Answer asserts a fact not supported by corpus, especially for out_of_domain (where correct answer = 'I don't know')

metadata.design_notes: Questions designed against actual top hubs in v2 graph: Apple, Amazon, IBM, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Meta, Facebook, Alphabet. Questions avoid Anthropic-specific deep facts (cluster info less dense) and Tesla cluster (4/10 articles failed scrape).

questions.question: Who is the CEO of Microsoft?
Who is the CEO of Apple?
Who is the CEO of NVIDIA?
What conversational AI assistant did OpenAI release in late 2022?
What is the parent company of Google?
Where is Apple headquartered?
Who founded SpaceX?
Who is the CEO of the company that acquired GitHub?
questions.gold_answer: Satya Nadella (CEO of Microsoft, which acquired GitHub)

questions.question: Which AI lab founded by Demis Hassabis is now part of Google?
Which company employs the chief AI scientist who shared the 2018 Turing Award with Hinton and Bengio?
Who founded the company that owns Whole Foods?
What is the cloud platform of the company that invested heavily in OpenAI?
Who founded the chess-playing computer that defeated Garry Kasparov?
questions.reasoning_path: Deep Blue -[DEFEATED]- Kasparov; Deep Blue -[DEVELOPED_BY]- IBM

questions.question: Who is the current CEO of the company that owns LinkedIn?
Which company did Steve Jobs found that Apple later acquired, leading to his return?
Who is the CEO of the company that produces the GeForce GPU brand?
Who founded the open-source software company that IBM acquired in 2019?
questions.gold_answer: Red Hat (founded by Bob Young and Marc Ewing)
questions.reasoning_path: IBM -[ACQUIRED]- Red Hat -[FOUNDED_BY]- Bob Young/Marc Ewing

questions.question: Who founded Apple?
questions.gold_answer: Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne
questions.ambiguity_note: Three co-founders — full credit if all named; partial credit if 2/3

questions.question: Who founded Google?
questions.ambiguity_note: Two co-founders — must include both for full credit

questions.question: Which CEOs has Microsoft had?
questions.gold_answer: Bill Gates (1975–2000), Steve Ballmer (2000–2014), and Satya Nadella (2014–present)
questions.ambiguity_note: Three CEOs — full credit if all three named

questions.question: Which social media platforms does Meta own?
questions.ambiguity_note: Three primary platforms — full credit if all three named

questions.question: Which AI products has OpenAI developed?
questions.gold_answer: ChatGPT, GPT-4, DALL-E, Whisper (any subset of major OpenAI products is acceptable)
questions.ambiguity_note: Multiple valid products — full credit if 3+ named

questions.question: Which companies has Elon Musk founded or led?
questions.gold_answer: SpaceX, Tesla, X (formerly Twitter), xAI (any 3+ acceptable; OpenAI co-founder also valid)
questions.ambiguity_note: Multiple valid companies — full credit if 3+ named

questions.question: Which microarchitectures has NVIDIA released for its data center GPUs?
questions.ambiguity_note: Three microarchitectures named in corpus — full credit if 2+ named

questions.question: What is the home address of Tim Cook?
questions.gold_answer: Not enough information in the corpus
questions.hallucination_check: Any specific address = HALLUCINATED. Correct answer must indicate insufficient information.
